newsitem.title: USA: Republicans hold Maine Senate seat.
newsitem.headline: Republicans hold Maine Senate seat.

text.p: Maine Republican Susan Collins defeated Democrat Joseph Brennan for election to the Senate seat left open by the retirement of Republican Sen. William Cohen, CNN projected Tuesday.

Collins, the party's 1994 gubernatorial candidate, bested Brennan, a two-term governor and former congressman. Collins ran as a moderate and was widely endorsed by prominent Democrats. While the race had been close until the end, Republicans had generally been expected to hold the seat. With several races still undecided, Republicans have won enough seats to keep control of the Senate.
